text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Today is Valentine's Day—the day when everyone exchanges special treats.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mostly out of curiosity, I go to check out the event area at the department store's food hall. However…
Do your best, Trainer! Don't think twice, just keep pressing forward!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Haha, what a coincidence. ♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Yep! We're on a date! ♪

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: No…

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I'm being dragged around. She made me go to this cafe with hideous decorations… and this stall that sold nothing but fluorescent stuff.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Haha! Not my fault that the city's filled with so many grammable spots on Valentine's Day.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Today, I'm taking Ayabe to all my favorites! ♪

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I know what you're thinking. Don't get the wrong idea.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: That's not why I'm here.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I… um… I want to say sorry… for what happened before the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I was completely wrong. I shouldn't have taken my frustration out on you like that.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I'm really sorry.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Ayabe…

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Sniffle…

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Sniffle… hic… That really… Sniffle… That really scared me, you know!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: It's like… It's like you were saying you didn't even care if you died!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: I… I… Sob…

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry… I really am. I don't feel like that anymore… And I would never say anything like that.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Well I don't forgive you! You have no idea how worried I was.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Yeah… You don't have to forgive me. It's your right not to.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: I won't forgive you—not now.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: You have to make it up to me first. Don't give me an apology. Give me your company. Lots and looots of it!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: …What?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: That's the only reason I'm here. It's what I have to do to apologize…

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Heeey, don't say thaaat. You're supposed to be having fun.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Today, I'm going to show you loooads of places and stuff that you've never seen before!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: You might even find something you didn't know you like.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Isn't that what's important for you now, Ayabe?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The silence after Curren Chan's statement reminds me of a previous discussion Admire Vega and I had.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Everything not related to running… I had to ignore everything I ever wanted.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I lived my whole life looking away, ignoring it all…

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: And now, I have no idea what to do.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She's in the process of picking up the pieces of herself she had abandoned. She's trying to live her life to the fullest, just like we talked about.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Finding something she likes is probably what she should be doing right now.
choice_data_list: Show her a good time, Curren!
Show her a good time, Curren!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Haha! You got it. ♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: All right, let's hit the next spot!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: H-hey! Hold on!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Later that evening…

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Oh…

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: We're bumping into each other a lot today…
choice_data_list: We sure are. Headed back to the academy?
We sure are. Headed back to the academy?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: No. Curren and I already went back to our dorm. And… I decided to go out again.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I wanted to see the stars.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I haven't been all that often… ever since she went away and we stopped being able to talk.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: But being dragged around by Curren today…

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: It made me feel like going out again.
choice_data_list: Guess that's one thing you certainly like.
Guess that's one thing you certainly like.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Right…

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I see. Yeah… I like that.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I smile at her softly as she affirms herself. Then, I notice there's a vending machine nearby and decide to buy her something for her stargazing trip.
choice_data_list: Would you like a hot drink to take with you?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I mention that I'm buying one for myself too, so it's no inconvenience to me. I wait a second for her to respond…

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Oolong tea… please. Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She gives me an answer far more readily than I had expected.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I watch her stroll off with an ever-so-slight bounce in her step. I wonder if I should spend the night by my window looking up at the stars myself.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I'll have an oolong tea then…

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: …No. Actually, what are you having?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I give it a little thought and recall the event I visited earlier this afternoon.
choice_data_list: I'm going to get a hot cocoa. It's Valentine's Day, after all.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: That's a weird reason.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: (But…)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I'll have the same.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After receiving the can of hot cocoa, Admire Vega jogs off toward the hill.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: (It's really sugary…)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: What a weird way to make a decision.
